1. MASTER runtime wiring absent: MASTER_TRUTH_ADDRESS/SIGNER/FETCHER/DEXES default empty/None and are populated only by test fixtures; normal runtime has no existing config/env wiring that makes MASTER truth executable.

3. Real send -> settlement lifecycle is unwired. maybe_auto_send_would_send does not attach the exchange oid/start time to the owning in-flight reservation and never invokes settle_from_master_evidence. Tests call the new method directly.
4. Real in-flight is memory-only. Restart after ACK but before independent settlement evidence resets self.in_flight={} and loses the blocker, permitting duplicate/overlapping authority.

7. Unrelated same-coin inventory protection is fixture-only: UNATTRIBUTED_INVENTORY is an empty in-memory global with no authoritative runtime derivation/recovery/persistence. Production cannot prove the unrelated sleeve offset after restart.
8. reconcile_sleeve() is test-only/unwired; production order authorisation does not fail closed on reconciliation divergence before convergence.
